sub_graphs.title: EIP-7441: Whisk Tracker Shuffling Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the multi-epoch shuffling process where candidate trackers are cryptographically permuted to achieve secret leader election.

nodes.label: New Shuffling Phase Started
nodes.description: A new 256-epoch shuffling phase begins; fresh proposer trackers are selected from candidates

nodes.label: Select Proposer Trackers
nodes.description: select_whisk_proposer_trackers() draws 8192 proposer trackers from the 16384 candidate tracker pool, weighted by effective balance

nodes.label: Refresh Candidate Trackers
nodes.description: select_whisk_candidate_trackers() samples active validators to refresh the candidate pool

nodes.label: Trackers Initialized for Phase
nodes.description: Both proposer (8192) and candidate (16384) tracker vectors are populated for the shuffling phase

nodes.label: Shuffle 124 Trackers Per Block
nodes.description: Each block proposer shuffles 124 candidate trackers using a zero-knowledge shuffle proof (Curdleproofs)

nodes.label: Trackers Partially Shuffled
nodes.description: Candidate trackers have been shuffled by some but not all blocks in the phase

nodes.label: Proposer Selection Gap (Cooldown)
nodes.description: 2-epoch gap (PROPOSER_SELECTION_GAP) before shuffled trackers are used for actual proposer selection

edges.label: Tracker permutation applied with ZK proof

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7441: Secret Proposer Selection and Revelation
sub_graphs.description: Models the anonymous proposer selection and the cryptographic proof required to claim a slot, which is the core security mechanism preventing targeted validator attacks.

nodes.label: Proposer Identity Unknown
nodes.description: For a given slot, the proposer identity is cryptographically hidden; only the proposer tracker (r_G, k_r_G) is known

nodes.label: Lookup Slot Proposer Tracker
nodes.description: Index into whisk_proposer_trackers using slot % PROPOSER_TRACKERS_COUNT to find the assigned tracker

nodes.label: Generate Whisk Opening Proof
nodes.description: The true proposer generates a zero-knowledge proof that they know secret k such that tracker.k_r_G = k * tracker.r_G

nodes.label: Validate Opening Proof
nodes.description: IsValidWhiskOpeningProof verifies the proposer's knowledge of k against the tracker and k_commitment

nodes.label: Proposer Identity Revealed
nodes.description: Block header reveals proposer_index only after the block is proposed, not before

nodes.label: Opening Proof Invalid
nodes.description: The opening proof failed validation; block is rejected

edges.label: True proposer recognizes their tracker and generates proof
Proof valid; proposer identity confirmed post-hoc

external_entities.name: Anonymous Block Proposer
external_entities.description: Validator whose identity is hidden until block proposal, protected by Whisk SSLE

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7441: Whisk Proof and Registration Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation pipeline for Whisk shuffle proofs, opening proofs, and first-time validator registration.

nodes.label: Block Received with Whisk Data
nodes.description: A beacon block has been received containing whisk_shuffle_proof, whisk_opening_proof, and related fields

nodes.label: Validate Shuffle Proof (Curdleproofs)
nodes.description: IsValidWhiskShuffleProof verifies post_shuffle_trackers are a valid permutation of pre_shuffle_trackers using ZK proof (max 32KB)

nodes.label: Validate Opening Proof
nodes.description: IsValidWhiskOpeningProof verifies proposer knows secret k matching their tracker (max 1KB proof)

nodes.label: Check k_commitment Uniqueness
nodes.description: is_k_commitment_unique verifies no duplicate k_commitments exist to prevent collisions

nodes.label: Validate First-Time Registration
nodes.description: For first proposal: verify whisk_tracker.r_G != BLS_G1_GENERATOR and registration proof is valid

nodes.label: All Whisk Validations Passed
nodes.description: Shuffle proof, opening proof, uniqueness, and registration checks all passed

nodes.label: Whisk Validation Failed
nodes.description: One or more Whisk validation checks failed; block rejected

edges.label: Shuffle proof valid (124 trackers permuted correctly)

external_entities.name: Block Proposer (via P2P)
external_entities.description: Validator submitting a block with Whisk proofs and tracker data over the P2P network

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clearly define what happens if a proposer's tracker has been shuffled out of the proposer tracker vector between selection and their slot.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the PROPOSER_SELECTION_GAP (2 epochs) ensures trackers are stable for the selection period. Trackers are only refreshed at phase boundaries.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between whisk_tracker and the validator's initial registration (r_G == BLS_G1_GENERATOR) is implicit in the registration logic.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume BLS_G1_GENERATOR is the sentinel value indicating an unregistered validator. First block proposal must provide a non-generator tracker with a valid registration proof.

ambiguities.text: The maximum proof sizes (32KB shuffle, 1KB opening) are specified but computational cost bounds for verification are not stated.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Curdleproof verification is bounded by constant-time operations proportional to the number of shuffled elements (124). Mark for benchmarking.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot reverse-engineer the proposer identity from the shuffled trackers without knowing the secret k values.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The entire SSLE scheme fails; attackers could identify and target upcoming proposers (DoS, MEV extraction, censorship).

implicit_assumptions.description: The Curdleproofs cryptographic scheme is sound and zero-knowledge, providing both shuffle validity and proposer privacy.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If Curdleproofs can be forged, malicious proposers could insert arbitrary trackers, hijacking future slots.

implicit_assumptions.description: Sufficient blocks are proposed during each 256-epoch shuffling phase to achieve adequate mixing of all 16384 candidate trackers.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Insufficient shuffling could leave trackers predictable, reducing the privacy guarantees of SSLE.
